name: Officer review and decision workflow
description: Verify that the officer MCP server allows searching, viewing, and deciding applications with proper audit trail.

cases.name: officer can search pending applications
cases.expected: returns list of pending applications in allowed blocks

cases.name: officer can view application with audit history
cases.expected: returns application details and audit trail

cases.name: officer can approve with note
cases.expected: status changes to APPROVED, audit_log entry created

cases.name: officer can reject with reason
cases.expected: status changes to REJECTED, audit_log entry created

cases.name: cannot decide non-pending application
cases.expected_error: Only a pending application can be decided
